baseline: Current adopted batch8 expert chain enabled;HC inject uses prior FP32 widening.
feature: BF16 HC inject,N4,K10240,beta0,ldy4. Pad weights to N8 in existing workspace,use original FP32-accumulator XMX kernel,copy four result columns. Repack every call,no persistent cache or engine allocation.
scope: Private isolated relink;current adopted batch8 baseline. 8 BF16 weight banks,128MiB workspace,all128 pool. Eight warmups,median7 batches x4 complete BF16 GEMM calls,including repack/copy/wait.
rule_before_measurement: A=current batch8 expert chain,HC inject via existing FP32 widening. B=same plus BF16 N4,K10240,beta0,ldy4 HC inject padded to N8 with original FP32-accumulator XMX kernel. No persistent cache/new allocation. 150 full CPU64-output/guard/random/short-exact-moved workspace/NaN-beta0/large-finite/fallback checks per process. Dyadic outputs must be exact and hash-identical across arms; random full-output absolute error<=0.005 vs CPU64. Screen then one confirmation,A/B/A/B/A each. Both candidate rounds require >=6 of11 stable T shapes (absolute adjacent-baseline drift<=3%),median throughput gain>=3%,no eligible regression<-3%. Only passing screen+confirmation proceed to separate host profiles and same-EXE IQ2_XS Code256 A/B/A/B/A: both prefill gains>=3%,drift<=3%,4191 slots/5760MiB and exact32 output IDs. No resampling. Profiles are attribution only,include existing waits,and add no GPU waits/barriers.
